edits.target: - The answer is one flat, bracket-balanced list `[{...}, {...}]` inside `<answer>` tags. Do not close the list early or leave stray brackets.
edits.content:
- LINE TEMPLATES (copy the shape; every call line has all three keys, each once, and ends `]},`):
  - required only: `{"tool name": "Shazam: songs/get-count", "required parameters": [{"name": "key", "value": "40333609"}], "optional parameters": []},`
  - optional only: `{"tool name": "Genius - Song Lyrics: Videos", "required parameters": [], "optional parameters": [{"name": "artist_id", "value": "16775"}, {"name": "per_page", "value": "15"}]},`
  - both filled: `{"tool name": "Blaze Verify: Verify an email", "required parameters": [{"name": "email", "value": "support@company-domain.com"}], "optional parameters": [{"name": "smtp", "value": "true"}, {"name": "timeout", "value": "10"}]},`
  - The LAST call line ends `]}` with no comma, and the next line is `]</answer>` (the closing `]` is never omitted).
  - A call line never ends in `"},`, `"}` or `], "},`. That is a half-written `optional parameters` key (real zero-score output: `"required parameters": [{"name": "key", "value": "40333609"}], "},`). Always write the full `"optional parameters": [...]` and then `}`.

(e.g. CheapShark `title`, `limit`; Flight Info `FlightNumber`; `Genius - Song Lyrics: Videos` `artist_id`, `per_page`; `The Legend of Zelda: List of The Legend of Zelda games` `name`, `limit`). This holds even when the value is the call's main entity or ID. Before writing each call, read its `Required parameters:` line: if it says `none`, write `"required parameters": []` and put every value in the optional list

- NAMED RETAILERS AND SHOPPING FILTERS. A 'compare across BestBuy, Wayfair, Zappos and Aliexpress' clause needs one search call per named retailer that has a keyword-search tool, so do not drop Aliexpress (`Aliexpress DataHub: Aliexpress - Item Search 2`, optional `q`, `region`=`US`, `currency`=`USD`, `page`=`1`) or BestBuy (`keyword`, `page`). A product search with a price range and 'free shipping' needs the tool whose optionals include `startPrice`, `endPrice` and `switches` (`Aliexpress DataHub: Aliexpress - Item Search 2`: startPrice=`600`, endPrice=`900`, `switches`=`freeShipping`). 'Some iPhone accessories' is a separate `Aliexpress DataHub: Aliexpress - Item Search` call with `q`. Never put a value outside an enum's listed options into a param (Shopee `site` accepts only my/th/vn/ph/sg/id/tw/br, so `US` is invalid and that tool cannot serve a US query).

'MX records' -> the MX tool; when `Email Existence Validator: Get the MX Records` is listed, use it (not `Email API: Check Email MX Records`), and that query's disposable clause then uses `Email Existence Validator: Check for Disposable emails`.

- MULTI-VALUE PARAMS. One clause naming several outlets or values, with a tool param that takes a comma-separated list, is ONE call with the values joined by commas and no spaces: 'from CNN and BBC' on `News API_v2: Search` -> required `q`=<topic>, optional `publisher`=`cnn.com,bbc.com`. Use N calls only when the param takes a single value. When the param description gives a literal for the request ('Use "global" for global stats'), pass that literal (`location`=`global`).
'first 20' or 'first 15 posts' on a paginated tool that has a page field -> the size field AND page `1` (pageSize `20` + page `1`; per_page `15` + page `1`);

edits.target: An unused number means a missed parameter.
edits.content: An unused number means a missed parameter. Count words are numbers too: 'rolled 5 dice once' -> dice `5`, rolls `1`; 'twice' -> `2`.

edits.target: - A named group or entity search -> the matching `by` field, when the schema offers one (e.g. `Group Name`).
edits.content: - A named group or entity search -> the matching `by` field, when the schema offers one (e.g. `Group Name`). A named person ('talks by X', 'songs by X') -> the schema's person field (`speaker`, `artist`, `author`), never dropped.

'at least 5 minutes' -> min_duration `300` (seconds).
  - Use the schema's own token, not the query's phrase: 'toys and games' -> category `toysgames` (copy it from the allowed-values list in the description); 'top 10' on a `range` param -> `1-10`; 'British English' -> `en-GB`.

edits.target: Never emit a parameter with an empty value.
edits.content: Never emit a parameter with an empty value. If the endpoint's own name already fixes a qualifier (`Dice Roll Simulator: Regular die` = six-sided, `Gas Price: canada`, `Moka News: Recent 50`), add no param for it and leave the lists `[]`.
